actual_response:
Three energy anomalies were detected for the week ending today, 2026-08-19:

* **Air Compressor AC-04 Specific Power Drift:** Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-19, AC-04 averaged a specific power of 7.114 kW per Nm3/min compared to a peer median of 6.103 kW per Nm3/min (16.6% excess). This creates an excess load of 41.2 kW while running. Based on an electricity price of 30.55 JPY/kWh and 8,000 run hours per year, the annual excess energy is 329,412 kWh, resulting in an annual cost impact of 10,065,059 JPY. The recommended action is to perform an ultrasonic leak survey and dryer purge valve inspection, running AC-04 as a standby unit until repaired [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.compressor_perf].

* **Sub-Meter M-27 Stuck Reading:** Sub-meter M-27 (monitoring production line LN-02) has been frozen at 696.5 kW across 623 consecutive 5-minute readings from 2026-08-17 09:35 to 2026-08-19 13:25. The receiving point energy balance residual shifted from 92.3 kW to 143.7 kW after the fault. This results in an unallocated consumption of 2,667 kWh, valued at 81,479 JPY. While receiving point settlement is unaffected, sub-meter measurement for gain share line items on feeder LN-02 is held until repaired [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.telemetry_5min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.meters, gain_share_agreement_summary.md Section 4].

* **Monthly Billing Peak Set Around Demand Response Event:** On 2026-08-06, site demand reached a monthly peak of 14,643.7 kW in the 2 hours prior to the 16:30 DR event. The battery provided 0 kW output during this window because it was held full for the event under rule_based_v1 control. The highest peak on non-event days was 13,933.6 kW. This created an extra billing demand of 710.1 kW, adding 1,065,116 JPY in monthly capacity charges (1,500 JPY/kW-month). The recommended action is to transition the battery to the forecast_aware_v2 control strategy to optimize both DR commitments and peak demand capping [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.site_load_30min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.jepx_prices_30min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.tariff_contract].

prompt: Any energy anomalies this week? Put a cost on them.
expected_response: Reference: see rubrics for scenario S4.
actual_response:
Three energy anomalies were detected for the week ending today, 2026-08-19:

* **Air Compressor AC-04 Specific Power Drift:** Between 2026-08-17 and 2026-08-19, AC-04 averaged a specific power of 7.114 kW per Nm3/min compared to a peer median of 6.103 kW per Nm3/min (16.6% excess). This creates an excess load of 41.2 kW while running. Based on an electricity price of 30.55 JPY/kWh and 8,000 run hours per year, the annual excess energy is 329,412 kWh, resulting in an annual cost impact of 10,065,059 JPY. The recommended action is to perform an ultrasonic leak survey and dryer purge valve inspection, running AC-04 as a standby unit until repaired [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.compressor_perf].

* **Sub-Meter M-27 Stuck Reading:** Sub-meter M-27 (monitoring production line LN-02) has been frozen at 696.5 kW across 623 consecutive 5-minute readings from 2026-08-17 09:35 to 2026-08-19 13:25. The receiving point energy balance residual shifted from 92.3 kW to 143.7 kW after the fault. This results in an unallocated consumption of 2,667 kWh, valued at 81,479 JPY. While receiving point settlement is unaffected, sub-meter measurement for gain share line items on feeder LN-02 is held until repaired [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.telemetry_5min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.meters, gain_share_agreement_summary.md Section 4].

* **Monthly Billing Peak Set Around Demand Response Event:** On 2026-08-06, site demand reached a monthly peak of 14,643.7 kW in the 2 hours prior to the 16:30 DR event. The battery provided 0 kW output during this window because it was held full for the event under rule_based_v1 control. The highest peak on non-event days was 13,933.6 kW. This created an extra billing demand of 710.1 kW, adding 1,065,116 JPY in monthly capacity charges (1,500 JPY/kW-month). The recommended action is to transition the battery to the forecast_aware_v2 control strategy to optimize both DR commitments and peak demand capping [melco_edge_to_grid_demo.site_load_30min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.jepx_prices_30min, melco_edge_to_grid_demo.tariff_contract].
